title: takas training-plan file
description: Optional input for the Plan day feature. takas only reads the fields below; anything else in the file is ignored.

type.description: Session kind; decides how the day becomes a route request (docs/plan.md)

session.description: Short name, e.g. "Hills 6×2 min" or "Long trail 30 km"

structure.description: Free text; parsed for warm-up/cool-down minutes, laps and gain targets

pace.description: e.g. "6:30–7:05/km"; the mean sets the time estimate
